versions.changelog:
Initial release – enables browser-based AI collaboration to save token usage.

- Controls the browser to let web-based AI handle planning/thinking, while the local Agent executes actions.
- Auto-detects browser engine (Chromium/Gecko) and guides tool setup for remote control.
- Supports multiple AI platforms (DeepSeek, Kimi, ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) with user-friendly mode/model selection.
- Ensures security by requiring manual user login and CAPTCHA verification.
- Outlines a step-by-step workflow for AI–Agent collaboration, with clear user confirmations and fallback instructions.
